title: Mixed Event — My Color!

meta.Outline: The MORE MORE JUMP! livestream kicks off to a great start! Things are going smoothly, until Shizuku's fear becomes a reality. Shizuku must reevaluate her past and present self in order to arrive at her ultimate decision.

rows.Line: Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew. That should do it for this morning's training.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Today is the day MORE MORE JUMP! has its first-ever livestream...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I need to be focused...)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay! The phone should be good right here!
Everyone happy with their hair and makeup?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I'm ready.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm a bit nervous, but let's give it our best.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've got a script, so we'll be fine as long as we do it the way we practiced! Well...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Urgh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Looks like someone isn't quite ready.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you alright, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-One sheep... Two sheep...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, isn't counting sheep for when you're trying to fall asleep?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, hold on...
I mean, to be fair, I'm nervous too and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There might be a lot of fans upset with the way we're trying to return to being idols.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But this is what we decided, so we gotta see it through!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's right. We need to do our best to explain our feelings on this stream!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello, everyone. Haruka Kiritani here...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And I'm Airi Momoi!
Thank you for joining us today!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I really get to see Haruka again!>
<Interesting grouping. What are your plans?>
<I thought you retired!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! So many comments already...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This is amazing...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, you two, hurry up and do your introductions...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's right...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shizuku Hinomori. I'm pleased to be here.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<It's Shizuku!>
<Shizuku... You're as beautiful as ever...!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I-I'm Minori Hanasato!
Nice to meet you all!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Who's that?>
<Never seen her before.>
<Put Haruka back on...!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Urgh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't worry, everyone's first time is always like this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're here to give everyone an important message.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<A message?>
<What could it be?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We apologize for resigning as idols so suddenly before...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our disappearance may have caused some of you to worry about us. That is why we'd like to start with an explanation.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I've been wondering about that.>
<Why'd you quit?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We each had our own reason for resigning when we did...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But the one thing we all had in common was the fact that we'd lost confidence in ourselves as idols...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, thanks to one of our members, we all managed to regain our passion and decided to become idols once again.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<So you're coming back?!>
<Yay!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Are you all returning to your old groups?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're very sorry, but we decided that we won't be returning to our old groups...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll be starting a new group of our own with the four members you see here.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<What? Why?>
<I feel bad for the others that worked so hard...>
<You're bailing on your old groups?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Those are great questions and we understand that many are going to feel like that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're all incredibly grateful to those who helped us get to where we are today, and hope to support them in any way we can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, we've decided to take different paths after talking things over with our old group members.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<But why?>
<Did you get into an argument and can't go back?>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<There were some rumors going around about Shizuku.>
<Hey, knock it off with the rude comments, guys!>
<Is it true you left because you were being bullied?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That's not it at all!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, Shizuku, and Airi were all worrying so much about whether or not they should keep being idols...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But they decided they wanted to keep giving their fans hope, so we joined forces!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <And who are you? lol.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Urgh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori is an irreplaceable member of our group.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She may not have experience as an idol, but I believe she's going to shine brighter than any of us one day. Please give her your support.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She's some kind of super idol in disguise?>
<She doesn't have that aura, you know...?>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <So where are you going from here?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've decided to start giving you a peek into our daily activities to tell you more about ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So leave a comment if there's anything you want to know! If it's something we can answer, we will!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <What agency are you with? MoriPro?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We're not affiliated with any agency.
We plan on freelancing.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<What?! You're not joining an agency?!>
<You can be a freelance idol?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. And we fully understand that it won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But with your support, we believe that we can accomplish anything.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This time around, the four of us are going to see things through.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We hope MORE MORE JUMP! can count on your support!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<As long as I get to see Haruka, I'm happy!>
<I'm behind you all the way, Shizuku!>
<Good luck, Airi...!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's great...!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well done, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We really went off-script there, didn't we...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. And it makes sense that so many people would be surprised at us coming back so soon after quitting...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
So we'll have to do our best to regain their trust.
We want them to be happy with supporting us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In that case, how about we all have our meeting in SEKAI tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I want to come up with a solid plan for what sort of videos MORE MORE JUMP! is going to make.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. I'd like to hear what Miku and the others have to say as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm all for it!
We need to do more, more, more!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I was really nervous, but I'm glad we were able to say everything we wanted to...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I feel like not being able to answer some of their questions might have worried a few fans.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But it's just like Haruka said... We have to do our best so our fans will want to support us.)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
Gasp! Is that Shizuku Hinomori?
She's as gorgeous as ever...!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
She always looks so perfect!
I bet she looks that good all the time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: I say we go with this as your image. It'll be a great selling point...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Everyone is expecting me to be perfect...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Right. I have to make sure not to let them down...)
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Miku! Rin!
Hmm. They're not here...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's rare for both of them to be away.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Maybe they're having dinner right now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Isn't it a bit early for that...
Wait, do they even eat dinner...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hello, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wah...! Miku!
You surprised me...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You seem a little different than usual. Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
I have a new friend to introduce to you all today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A new friend?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! We have someone who's going to be performing as an idol with us from now on♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? Who is it...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Time for the big reveal!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It's nice to meet you.
My name is Megurine Luka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: L-Luka...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to putting on some wonderful shows with Miku and Rin from now on.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I hope I can count on your support♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow! What an aura...!
You're dazzling!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're over-exaggerating, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? You already know my name?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of course. Miku and Rin told me all about you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Like you four discovering your true feelings and forming your own idol group...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And we even talked about a few embarrassing stories that I probably shouldn't repeat in front of everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?! Wait, what are you talking about?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Could it be that... D-Did you see me practicing my autograph last night...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You were practicing your autograph, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm just teasing♪
I was just trying to surprise everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm hoping to get to know more about each of you, so feel free to chat any time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sigh... Don't scare me by saying stuff like that...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You seem like quite the playful type, Ms. Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Well, thank you...
But there's no need to be so formal with me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, then... Just Luka is okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Thank you, Shizuku♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It feels like we're already friends.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka's great at singing, dancing, and talking to the crowd♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah♪ She can really do everything!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I sort of had the impression that Luka's reliable and ladylike, and I guess this means she really is.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah! Her idol aura is so strong too!
Her charisma has to be off the charts!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're right. I'm a little jealous.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? But you're always shining too, Shizuku! You're a great singer and dancer, and I love how you can do anything!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, well... I can't do everything...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It actually takes me longer to memorize songs and dance routines than most.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku may not be the type that can pick up something new immediately, but she makes up for it with her work ethic.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's surprising...
I never would've guessed...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Anyway, shall we get started with our meeting?
We'd love to get your input as well, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! You really started doing livestreams?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yep. We only just did our introduction video, but we're planning on doing more moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, how did it feel, livestreaming?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's really wonderful that we got to see everyone's comments in real-time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Since this was such an important announcement, we thought about recording it beforehand so that we could edit it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I feel like doing it live allowed us to express our feelings better than we could have in a recorded video.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I think so too!
Some of the comments were a bit harsh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But seeing everyone's comments right then and there really made it feel like our feelings reached them! It was really nice!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I get the feeling MORE MORE JUMP! is actually perfectly suited for livestreaming.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. I think our focus should be on livestreaming for the time being.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Focus on... Livestreams...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Our last video was just us doing a short introduction, so I was able to get through it without any issues...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But if we keep doing live videos, I...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Do you have any idea what kinds of streams you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well... There's lots of things I'd like to try, but nothing really concrete. Do you have any ideas, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, well... Um...
I'm sorry. Not off the top of my head.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, that's a tough one. How about you, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not sure. I can't really think of anything specific on the spot either...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But doing something you think the fans will enjoy is probably the best way to go, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something our fans will enjoy...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh!
I just thought of something!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nice! That was quick!
What have you got, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!... Um... What about showing everyone what we're usually like?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What we're usually like?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! From the fans' perspective, getting the chance to see how their favorite idols act when the cameras are off would feel like a special treat!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They normally only get to see idols on TV or while they're performing, right? I bet seeing everyone in a new light would make them like you even more...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A side of us that we don't show on TV or on stage...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's true. There are a lot of fans out there that like behind-the-scenes stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Won't some of the fans get disillusioned if they learn too much about that side of us?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's definitely a possibility. There are sure to be fans who would prefer not to know what their idols are like in their private lives.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-You think so?
I was always happy to learn...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think it's a really interesting idea! Personally, I think everyone in MORE MORE JUMP! is always super cute♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um... O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If it's worrying you, we can come up with other ideas before making a decision.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The fans are expecting me to be perfect, so that means I can't let my guard down even if it's a behind-the-scenes look.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I can't let my personal circumstances limit what the others can do. Especially not now after finally getting started.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (As long as I can maintain this perfect persona at all times...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm probably overthinking it.
Your idea is wonderful, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Are you really sure it's okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm fine.
I didn't mean to make you worry.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Then let's start planning some content with that idea in mind. Miku, Rin, Luka, thank you for the feedback.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're very welcome!
I'm looking forward to your streams♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm sure the fans will love it too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope so too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to do my best to not disappoint the fans...)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, let's just focus on practicing our singing and dancing like normal, while responding to comments as we go for today's stream.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As long as we sort of stick to the plan, we're basically free to just do as we like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, don't be so tense. We're supposed to be showing everyone how we usually are, so try to relax a little.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You've been acting a little off lately...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Are you worried about being able to maintain the image you had from back when you were in Cheerful*Days?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes...
A little...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Your fans tend to be more passionate than most, right? I remember even hearing a lot of girls scream, I love you, Shizuku! during your shows.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you're you, Shizuku. As long as you work as hard as you always do, I'm sure the fans will cheer you on.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And if anything does happen, I'm here for you. So let's just do our best, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. Thank you, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She's right. This is only the first of many livestreams. I just need to do my best.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Good afternoon!
Thank you for joining us again today!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Haruka!>
<She's here!>
<So cute as usual!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Today, we'd like to show you a bit of our everyday routine!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's right. First off, we'd like to show you what a typical dance practice looks like for us!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I wanna see your dance practice!>
<I can't wait!>
<Good luck!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! We'll give it our best!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Who's that again?>
<Oh, I forgot about her.>
<Give us more Shizuku...!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Urgh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to give it my all. I can't afford to mess up...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Airi, you're a bit fast!
And Minori, you're about one beat behind!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Next, I move to the center and turn...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku, that was a great turn!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, thank goodness...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Well done, everyone.
We're starting to sync up nicely.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Shizuku was on her game today too.
Pure perfection!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<That's because Shizuku's a great dancer!>
<Nah, she's good at everything!>
<Shizukuuu!!!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: See? Everyone else thinks so too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's take a quick break before we do some singing practice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Great idea!
I'm parched...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Phew... Where'd I put that water...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hm... Waaah!
I dropped it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm fine. But I just spilled all my water...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Is the newbie a klutz?>
<Haha! That was pretty funny!>
<Airi, give her some of yours.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sure, take some of...
Oh, I already drank it all...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Would you like some of mine?
I still have about half in my thermos.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Shizuku's so nice...>
<Lucky! I want some of Shizuku's water!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Make sure to drink it while it's still warm.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
While it's still warm...?
Did you bring tea today?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, it's miso soup.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, what?! Miso soup?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Miso soup right after practice? You're joking, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sure, why not? It's nice and filling after a hard workout. Plus, it even helps warm you up after you get chilly from sweating so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I suppose that makes sense, but I think I'll stick with water or a sports drink after practicing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's so like you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hahaha. It sure is!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hm? Look at the comments...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Was Shizuku always like this?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: *Gasp*...!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She's different from what I imagined.>
<Is she going for a new image?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku tends to get cold easily, so she usually prefers warm drinks! Isn't that right...?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<That's actually kind of interesting.>
<That's not the Shizuku I want to see.>
<She always seemed more refined, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Stop arguing in the comments.>
<Miso soup? This has to be scripted lmao.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What do we do? The comments just keep coming...!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <This isn't Shizuku.>

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: I say we go with this as your image. It'll be a great selling point...

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Got it? When you're on TV, all you have to do is smile. You can leave the talking to the other members up on stage.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: You're sure to get more fans this way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was being so careful...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But in the end, I can't be perfect...
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, everyone.
Our livestream was a disaster because of me...

rows.Speaker: Minori

Airi Momoi from MORE MORE JUMP! here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For our third stream, we'll be doing some Brutal Dance Training!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're gonna be learning an even harder dance routine than we did last time! And we're not stopping until we master it!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<You can do it!>
<Haruka's dancing too?!>
<You can do it, Airi...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I took another look at the choreography before the stream, but this really is a tough song...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Even for you, Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. It's going to take quite a bit of work to master this one.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even so, there's nothing we can do but give it our best! Right, Shizuku?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Well, Shizuku's a great dancer so...>
<I doubt Shizuku will have any trouble!>
<Good luck, everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, everyone...
We appreciate your support.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I have to see this through.
To give everyone hope!)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: One, two, and turn!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Cross my arms then swing...)

rows.Speaker: Minori.
rows.Line: Eek!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori.
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah. Sorry about that.
You were all doing fine and...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
There's no need to apologize.
You were doing great, Minori, so let's keep going!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Man, this looks super tough.>
<I'd be dead in ten minutes.>
<Can you really master this in a day?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Idols are all about determination! This is only the beginning and we're gonna utterly master this dance!

rows.Speaker: Minori.
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Next, I step in behind Airi and...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Eek...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, you okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, sorry.
I just tripped...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't sweat it. Let's try it again!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (This time, I'll get it...)

rows.Speaker: Minori.
rows.Line: Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Whoa? She messed up again?>
<Hold on, is Airi actually a better dancer than Shizuku?>
<Wasn't expecting that...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone seems pretty tired. Maybe we should take a breather...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree...
Please, take a break.

rows.Speaker: Minori.
rows.Line: Huh? What about you, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm going to keep practicing a little more.

rows.Speaker: Minori.
rows.Line: B-But shouldn't you rest?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Don't worry about me. I'll only be a little longer.

rows.Speaker: Minori.
rows.Line: But Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't worry. Shizuku's always been like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She struggles so much at the beginning, but ends up putting in even more effort when nobody's looking.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's how she gradually becomes the perfect Shizuku everyone sees on stage.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I want to see Shizuku's solo practice!>

rows.Speaker: Minori.
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I don't like seeing her trip and fall this much but...>
<I want to see too! Can you show us?!>
<Point the camera at Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Minori.
rows.Line: Haruka! Airi!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure, let's show them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right...! I feel a little bad for doing this without asking, but I'm sure Shizuku will understand.

rows.Speaker: Minori.
rows.Line: Then let's just rotate the camera this way and...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She's been working this hard behind the scenes?>
<She always looks so composed. I wasn't expecting this.>
<She looks so determined! lol.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I always thought she was just perfect at everything.>
<I guess it makes sense that she works this hard.>
<It's so different from what I imagined...>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Seeing how much effort she puts into becoming the perfect Shizuku we all know is actually pretty moving.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Watching her like this makes me want to work even harder too.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sorry, I was concentrating so much that I lost track of time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I think that should do it.
I think I can manage now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay....
Show us what you can do!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And this next part...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I want to show my fans that I can do this...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I don't want anyone to regret supporting me up to this point! I may not be perfect, but I still want to give them hope!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, one last time!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I... I finished the whole thing...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Great job, everyone.
We made it through the entire routine.

rows.Speaker: Minori.
rows.Line:
N-No more...
I can't move a muscle.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, Minori! Are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's give her a chance to catch her breath. She did great considering we just threw her into the deep end with such a brutal song.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
Minori really is amazing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She is... But I think today's MVP is you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku, wasn't there something you wanted to say to our viewers?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's right...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everyone... There's something I would like to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<What is it?>
<We're all ears!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I believe the idol I was as part of Cheerful*Days was a much better idol than I am today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, that version of me was only made possible thanks to all the support she had. She wasn't the true me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure you would all rather see the old version of me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
However... I'm sorry.
I can no longer be her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: While I may not be able to give you the perfect version of myself you were all hoping for...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm still going to try my very best to inspire everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So please... If you'll have me, I would very much like it if you would continue to support me.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I'll love any version of you, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: *Gasp*...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Thank you for being so honest!>
<You'll always have my support!>
<Not what I was expecting, but you've got my support.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Going forward, we'd like to show you all a new side of ourselves. As members of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We promise to work even harder than before to live up to your expectations. We look forward to your support!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I can't wait!>
<I'll be cheering for you!>
<Let's all do our best, together!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew... Thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Shizuku! Good job!
You got through it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you. I couldn't have done it without you all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And thank you especially, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori.
rows.Line: Huh? But I didn't do anything.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's not true at all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The fact that you supported me and said you like me just the way I am is what gave me the strength to make this decision.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You gave me the courage I needed, Minori.
Thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Minori.
rows.Line:
I-If you say so...
I'm just glad I could help.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, Shizuku! Let's re-watch the stream!
We got tons of great comments!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sure!
